name: nowledge-mem-openai
description: Nowledge Mem for ChatGPT and Codex: shared context, memory search, and durable handoffs.

interface.longDescription: Nowledge Mem gives ChatGPT and Codex a durable, user-controlled memory workspace. Search relevant context, read Working Memory, distill decisions, and save explicit handoffs through the authenticated Nowledge Cloud MCP server. ChatGPT uses explicit save and handoff actions; Codex lifecycle hooks remain available only in the dedicated Codex connector.
defaultPrompt: What do we already know about this?
Find the relevant context from my Nowledge Mem.
Save the durable takeaways from this work.
